subject: Ops TimeQuilt: Redwood x CloudForge co-sell demo — timing coordination
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@cloudforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudForge Demo Ops <ops@cloudforge.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ops TimeQuilt: Redwood x CloudForge co-sell demo — timing ask

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for lining this up. CloudForge is excited to showcase the joint accelerator flow for Marketplace buyers (AWS + Redwood orchestration). Our PMs would like to see the full end-to-end run covering: provisioning, model selection, and failover routing. To keep ops risk low, we propose three short candidate windows (all UTC):

- 2026-07-06 15:00–15:45 UTC
- 2026-07-07 20:00–20:45 UTC
- 2026-07-09 02:00–02:45 UTC

Can you confirm Redwood availability, and whether you need an AWS engineer in the call? If AWS needs to be present, cc'ing Aisha Shah from the AWS partner team — Aisha, are you able to attend one of the above?

We can provide a short agenda PDF and a rehearsal beforehand. Also confirm if recording is OK for post-demo assets.

Thanks,
Daniel
CloudForge — Partnerships

Attachment: proposed-agenda.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ops TimeQuilt: Redwood x CloudForge co-sell demo — timing ask

Daniel,

Appreciate the windows and the clear scope. Quick answers:
- Karthik (tech lead) can cover the orchestration + failover bits on Redwood.
- Priyom will be our partner-facing point for flow + marketplace listing details.

Two notes from our side: the 2026-07-06 slot hits a pre-scheduled town hall for a couple of our ops engineers; 2026-07-07 works for most of the US team but might be late for APAC. 2026-07-09 02:00 UTC is doable but it's very late for product (we prefer to avoid overnight demos if we can).

If AWS presence is required, we defer to Aisha to pick the window. Otherwise we can run with Redwood + CloudForge and have AWS join asynchronously and field questions. Recording is fine — we typically keep demo recordings for 90 days.

Can you share a rehearsal time (30 min) the week prior? Attached a quick attendee list I'm starting (attendee-list.csv).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick scheduling update from the AWS side (Aisha, fyi):

AWS has a product briefing the afternoon of 2026-07-07; Aisha indicated she can't join the 20:00 UTC slot. If we need an AWS engineer live, the two options that seem realistic for US/APAC overlap are:

- 2026-07-06 18:00–18:45 UTC (i.e., move the 15:00 slot later)
- 2026-07-08 14:00–14:45 UTC (a fresh daytime option)

Vanessa note: the 07-08 daytime option helps European buyers as well. If you prefer to keep 07-07 but without AWS live, we can go ahead and run it with Redwood + CloudForge; AWS can drop written answers into the chat or send a follow-up note.

Also — we prefer a rehearsal 48–72 hours prior with the full tech stack present (this catches ephemeral network/KMS edge cases).

—Vanessa
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Marissa — thanks for the fast responses. We can accommodate the later 07-06 18:00 UTC option (that works for our PM + one of our dev leads) and 07-08 14:00 UTC is also acceptable. Our preference is 07-06 18:00 UTC since that keeps momentum.

Aisha — if you can confirm AWS availability for 07-06 18:00 UTC we'd prefer to lock that. If AWS can't make that, we'll proceed with Redwood + CloudForge on 07-06 and capture a short AWS Q&A asynchronously.

Also adding a HubSpot link for the deal so your CS/sales teams can attach notes: https://hubspot.company/hub/HB-4982

Locked: 2026-07-06 18:00–18:45 UTC (Calendar invite sent)

Thanks everyone — locking the 07-06 18:00 UTC window per Daniel's preference and AWS tentative availability. Calendar invite includes:
- Agenda (short run-through + failover test)
- Attendees: Redwood ops, CloudForge PM + dev lead, AWS partner rep (Aisha) — added in event as optional until Aisha confirms.
- Rehearsal: 2026-07-05 16:00 UTC (30 min) — please treat this as mandatory for any live participants.

Attachments: runbook-v1.docx (DOCX stub) — this contains the demo checklist, KMS notes, and fallback steps. Priyom — please drop marketplace listing notes into the HubSpot thread (HB-4982) so we have the linkable snippet for buyers.

Recording is OK; we'll keep it in Redwood's internal Share for 90 days and share the short clip for co-marketing if CloudForge approves.

If AWS needs to move to 07-08 14:00 UTC, we'll update the calendar but keep rehearsal timing consistent. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
